rationale: The agent correctly enforced authentication before attempting any order modifications and appropriately declined to proceed without verification. It also provided accurate details and pricing for the purple S polyester v‑neck variant and listed only available variants. However, it gave an incorrect count of available t‑shirt options at the start (stated 11 when tool data shows 10 available). Providing incorrect product information violates the requirement to avoid unsupported or fabricated statements. Therefore, despite proper handling of authentication and later correct info, the conversation fails the pass bar due to the initial inaccurate answer.
